answers.reason: The senate is a central body for university statutes, structure, and strategy, not listed as part of the faculty administrative officer's remit.
The budget planning round is handled by university leadership and central administration, not the faculty administrative officer.
The appointment committee is for selecting professorship candidates and does not include the faculty administrative officer.
The faculty administrative officer organizes records and examinations for the faculty but is not stated as a member of the faculty council.
The study commission advises on teaching and prepares changes to degree programmes without the faculty administrative officer as a member.
The examination board decides on individual student examination matters, which the faculty administrative officer organizes, but membership on the board is not granted.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects, which falls outside the faculty administrative officer's duties.
The module revision working group rewrites module descriptions, which is not the administrative officer's role.
Laboratory equipment procurement chooses equipment for a teaching laboratory, not part of the administrative officer's responsibilities.
Orientation week planning plans the program for new students and is unrelated to the administrative officer's stated tasks.
